profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Alloy | Ex-Google
profile.summary:
Former farm-town kid turned frontend software engineer 🚜👩‍💻

please do not contact me about ai startup opportunities

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- own our workflow editor; a highly interactive react-based editor that allows end users to configure and edit graph-like & tree-like data
- led an effort to establish org-wide coding standards
- continuing to make, break, and deliver things

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- independently delivered front end code changes for a customer-facing web-based messaging experience, connecting Search users with merchants
- assisted in delivering Away Mode for Google Business Messaging
- ensured testing suite is up to date alongside code functionality changes
- given UX mocks, identify required changes & write design + launch proposals accordingly
- communicated cross-teams to align on engineering processes & get design feedback
- proactively identified code health issues & testing pipeline fixes outside of product work priorities
- drove service outage reports

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- maintained customer-facing front-end experience with an emphasis in market scalability
- developed and delivered a brand new experience (specifically: Amex’s Banking and Checking product release) within a team setting
- followed and maintained CICD measures within the large-scale organization
- contributed to centralized internal documentation for other employees to learn from
- developed internal tools outside of immediate product releases / required responsibilities to save developers’ time and improve developers’ experience
- presented technical concepts to colleagues + VP’s + SVP

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- built an internal debugging tool / chrome extension from the ground up using Javascript's React framework over 4 weeks in a group of 4 interns
- ensured continuous integration / development and code style rules were followed via git hooks and git lab tests
- internationalized extension to allow for additional languages to be added

positions.title: Software Product Sprint Student
positions.description:
- participated in an invite-only 12 week training program that trains students on industry workflow
- built full-stack web apps individually and within a team setting using HTML / CSS / JavaScript and Java
- received mentorship from a Senior Google Engineer throughout app development
Read more about the program here:
https://buildyourfuture.withgoogle.com/programs/softwareproductsprint/
positions.insights: Skills: Google API · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Java · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
-Created a CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) feature for an internal tool aimed to improve productivity and assist administrators 
-Developed front-end using React-Redux and Bootstrap libraries
-Collaborated with one other intern in an AGILE work environment

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
-Collaborated with peers on the creation of a large-scale research study in the Computer Science field
-Analyzed data from multiple semesters of a 200+ student course in excel
-Presented individually-developed projects in front of 50+ researchers

https://cra.org/cra-wp/2018-dreu-participants/

honors.title: Grace Hopper Scholar
honors.description: Sponsored by AnitaB to attend the 2019 Grace Hopper Celebration in Orlando, FL

honors.title: CRA-W Grace Hopper Conference Research Scholar
honors.description:

volunteerExperiences.companyName: MinneCoders Camp at University of Minnesota
volunteerExperiences.description:
- Assisted in teaching Middle School - High School aged girls in learning basic coding concepts and basic web development with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Cultivated an effective and fun learning environment

Related Links:
https://theconnectory.org/opportunity/minnecoders--august-2019

company.name: MinneCoders Camp at University of Minnesota

volunteerExperiences.description:
- teamed up with 4 colleagues to coordinate and execute an outreach classroom teaching session for CS education week
- taught basic coding concepts to ~25 6th graders

See the curriculum here: https://csfirst.withgoogle.com/c/cs-first/en/hour-of-code/overview.html

projects.title: TrickTracker
projects.description:
- enables users to track & document their skating progression using JavaScript & Java Servlets in a timeline format
- Supports user profiles using OAuth library & video media storage using Google storage + blobs API’s

projects.title: Writing effective programming exercises for Automated Grading using Bloom's Taxonomy
projects.description:
-Published in the ACM & presented at SIGCSE 2019
-Research study implemented in a Fall 2018 intro to programming course with data analysis occurring Spring 2019
-Examining if scaling question complexities from lower to higher orders of Bloom's Taxonomy will improve student performance, learning efficiency, and/or students' perceptions of their learning experience

organizations.name: Association of Computing Machinery - Women's Chapter (ACM-W)
organizations.description:
Assisted in the execution of student-led events
Responsible for student outreach and tabling events
Organized members to perform classroom visits for outreach purposes

http://acmw.umn.edu/about/2019-2020-officers

organizations.name: Computing Research Association - Women's Chapter (CRA-W)
organizations.description: Participated in a research program that distributes student researchers across the country
